chunks: Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام used to gather firewood, draw water, and sweep, while Fatimah عليها السلام used to grind, knead, and bake.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, referring here to Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.فَاطِمَةُ: Fatimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: How did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and Fatimah عليها السلام divide household work?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the shared domestic labor of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام and Fatimah عليها السلام in their household. It highlights humility, cooperation, and the dignity of everyday work in family life.
